Name: PlaylistButtonPlugin
Author: Jan
Description: GPIO button control for playlists: short print opens an overlay menu with all playlists (alphabetical, current ones marked) and scrolls through the list when pressed again briefly. After 10 seconds of inactivity, the overlay closes again without changing the active playlist. A long key press takes over the playlist marked in the menu as a new active playlist.

Settings.Name: GpioPin
Settings.Description: BCM pin number of your button, e.g. 21. Empty after installation: enter a pin that is not used by another plugin or device. A change takes effect within a few seconds.

Settings.Name: LongPressSeconds
Settings.Description: Hold time in seconds from which a print is considered 'long' and the playlist changes

Settings.Name: OverlayTimeoutSeconds
Settings.Description: Seconds without pressing a key, after which the selection overlay is automatically hidden

Settings.Name: OverlayFileName
Settings.Description: Overlay layout file that is activated when the menu is displayed (must contain a text element with the source PlaylistButtonPlugin.MenuText)

Settings.Name: OnlyEnabledPlaylists
Settings.Description: When active, only playlists with isEnabled=true are displayed in the menu

Settings.Name: FontSize
Settings.Description: Font size (in px) of the playlist selection menu in the overlay

Settings.Name: ShowFolderPlaylists
Settings.Description: When active, in addition to the saved playlists, all folder playlists (folder playlists) are also displayed alphabetically in the menu

Settings.Name: VisibleLines
Settings.Description: Maximum number of lines visible simultaneously in the menu. For longer lists, the menu becomes a scrolling window.

Settings.Name: AnchorLine
Settings.Description: Line number (1-based) in which the selection marker remains as soon as there are enough entries above it (e.g. 4 = arrow clicks into the 4th line, list scrolls below/above it).

Settings.Name: FolderCacheSeconds
Settings.Description: How long (in seconds) the list of folder playlists is cached before it is queried again from the engine on a menu call. Higher value = faster menu opening, but newly created folders only appear after the cache time has expired.

Services.description: Alphabetical list of all playlists, including the current selection and the active playlist
Permanently monitors the GPIO button and controls playlist changes via the Slideshow API.
